name: Cable Hammer Preacher Curl
steps: Sit at a preacher bench facing a low cable rope with your upper arms against the pad and your palms facing each other.
Bend your elbows to lift the rope ends toward your shoulders.
Lower your hands until your elbows are nearly straight.
tips: Keep your upper arms resting on the pad through the full motion.
Keep your wrists straight and lower under control without snapping your elbows straight.
